title: The Paired Fang School Course
summary: A school course in paired fangs of venom that strike on one beat and close on the crowned fangs of the school's finishing stroke.

title: Manual of the Azure Court Venom
summary: A school manual of cobalt venom taught in the two-handed style of the azure court and closed by its judgement stroke.

title: The Twin Bloom Treatise
summary: A school treatise on two blooms of venom opened side by side so that their mists cross and thicken into the school's deepest stroke.

title: The Hawk and Basin Miasma Canon
summary: A school canon that joins the diving venom of the hawk with the settled miasma of the basin and ends in a core-fed stroke.

title: The Wind-Sworn Venom Course
summary: A school course in venom sworn to the wind: darts that keep faith with their mark and a closing stroke that cannot be turned.

title: Manual of the Oath of Slow Death
summary: A school manual of the oath that a poison once laid shall run its course; it teaches doses that sink in stage by stage.

title: The Bearing Toxin Treatise
summary: A school treatise on taking a bearing with the poison itself: toxin that homes on a mark across the open field.

title: The Open Plateau Hemlock Canon
summary: A school canon of hemlock qi spread openly over a wide field with nothing hidden and a core-fed closing stroke.
